title: AgentFrontmatterSchema
description: Google Antigravity Custom Agent YAML frontmatter schema (.agents/agents/<name>.md) per Section 4.3 specification.

description.description: Detailed explanation of agent specialization and delegation criteria used by the planner (Required).

tools.description: Permitted tool names available to this agent (e.g., view_file, grep_search, run_command).

mainAgent.description: Allow selection as primary agent persona in interactive chat.

subagent.description: Allow invocation as a delegated worker via invoke_subagent.

model.description: Model tier override ('inherit', 'flash', 'pro', or specific model name).

mcpServers.description: Custom MCP server definitions scoped to this subagent.

skills.description: Skill identifiers or plugin-qualified skill paths (e.g. 'plugins/superpowers/skills/code-review').

plugins.description: Plugin dependencies required for this agent.
